name: Riksgränsen

seo.title: Riksgränsen ski resort guide
seo.description: Sweden's northernmost ski resort, on the Norwegian border at 68 degrees north: mostly off-piste skiing, heliski, and extreme skiing championships every May.
seo.twitterDescription: 68 degrees north, mostly off-piste, heliski, and May championships.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, terrain, where to stay and how to get to Riksgränsen in Norrbotten, Sweden.

h1: Riksgränsen ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Riksgränsen sits on the Norwegian border at 68 degrees north, where much of the skiing is off-piste rather than on marked slopes. The resort names Uffes vägg, Rimfors and Nordalsfjäll as its challenges, sells heliskiing of its own, and the Swedish extreme skiing championships are held on Nordalsfjäll every May.
stayOverview: Riksgränsen is a settlement rather than a village: a handful of buildings at the border station on the Ofoten railway line. Björkliden, under the same operator, is the quieter alternative down the line.
hotelIntro: Book against the season you intend to ski. This far north the season runs late rather than early, and the extreme skiing championships are in May.
rentalCars: The Ofoten railway runs through Riksgränsen between Kiruna and Narvik, so this is one of the few Swedish resorts where the train leaves you at the door.

travelTips.title: Mostly off-piste
travelTips.text: The resort says much of the skiing here is off-piste, with countless easily reached lines alongside the marked slopes.

travelTips.title: The named challenges
travelTips.text: Uffes vägg, Rimfors and Nordalsfjäll are the ones the resort points strong skiers at.

travelTips.title: Three mountains, one operator
travelTips.text: Riksgränsen, Björkliden and Låktatjåkko share an operator.

highlights.text: The Swedish national championships in extreme skiing are held here every May.

season.note: Riksgränsen opens late and closes late - it sits north of the Arctic Circle and skis into the midnight sun.
